intro: Founder-led delivery at Teton Web — building AI orchestration platforms, advising enterprise clients, and shipping production systems with Cursor as the daily driver.

roles.title: Founder & Lead Developer
bullets: Founded and lead Teton Web, a specialized web development and AI orchestration consultancy delivering high-impact platforms and internal tooling for clients across industrial equipment, global nonprofit, insurance brokerage, and inventor-network markets. Serve as trusted technical advisor and de facto CTO on AI/web strategy.

Architected and productionized sophisticated AI multi-agent orchestration systems that serve as force multipliers for development velocity, including Slack-based agents, cross-device automation, Linear/Slack task orchestration, and routine-maximization workflows. These platforms demonstrate large-scale AI adoption in complex environments—directly analogous to enterprise rollout challenges.

Pioneered advanced Cursor extensions, including Composer 2.5 skills that dynamically coordinate parallel sub-agents for issue execution and branch-management workflows. Public demos showed dramatic acceleration, providing real-world proof points for AI maturity and workflow transformation.

Led high-context client engagements, including major design-system proposal work, international platform/catalog delivery, and alumni-platform strategy facilitation. Full-stack work with Cursor as the daily-driver development environment across Next.js, Convex/Neon, Vercel, and Figma workflows.

Developing an ambitious all-in-one small business SaaS platform spanning website/CMS/CRM, realtime workflows, and AI. Manage proposals, contracts, financials, and multi-tenant architecture while thriving in ambiguous, fast-paced settings.
